style.backgroundSystem: dusty teal seamless panels with lighter horizontal stripes, clean white infographic screens, warm cream info blocks
style.iconSystem: thin monoline icons in #2B3A55 inside thin circular outlines, single accent mark per icon
style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio light, front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadow, no harsh specular
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh youthful ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of dusty teal #B7CDD1 panels, clean white #FFFFFF screens, deep navy #2B3A55 for text and trims, and coral #E8604C as the single accent; soft cool studio lighting with front-left key and gentle contact shadow; modern geometric sans-serif short headlines only; consistent thin circular outline icons; clean product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement with natural breathing room around the product; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no serif or handwritten display type
style.presentationRules: full views keep a stable eye-level front 3/4 hero angle, product centered with soft contact shadow; macros switch angle deliberately
style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper panels and light matte ground; fabric weave texture appears only in macro shots
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, short headlines in 「」, headline 28-48pt, labels 10-14pt
